correctness.rationale: The kernel recurrence h[i+1]=−h[i] gives zero kernel at odd length; the proper-coloring transfer matrix has trace 4^n−4 then. At even length the unrestricted image is the alternating-sum hyperplane. In an affine fiber with a proper source, the shift t makes edge i improper precisely at t=z_i, so a support of size r leaves 5−r valid shifts. Alternating-sum closure of z is both necessary and sufficient, with five choices of starting symbol. At each two-letter support, the nontrivial squared Fourier magnitudes of 1+ζ^(a d), d≠0, are (3±√5)/2 twice each. A three-letter support omits one nonzero letter and has the same nontrivial magnitudes. The one- and four-letter cases give E₁=1 and E₄=(16^m+4)/5. Subset inversion gives T₁=4, T₂=6E₂−12, T₃=4E₃−12E₂+12, T₄=E₄−4E₃+6E₂−4; source incidence (5−r)A_(2m,5−r)=5T_r then reproduces all four counts. Constant outputs are precisely the degree-four fibers. The image sizes for n=2,4,6 are 5,125,2765, with the first deficit 3125−2765=360. The leading nonsingleton term is 2·9^m, while the image is asymptotic to 16^m. Direct exact enumeration in /workspace/branches/8afd4b80-ce2a-40f7-b17b-af00d46900be/check_inverse_spectrum.py reproduced the histograms for n=2–8, including (1620,960,180,5,0) at n=6. This is finite corroboration. The supplied checker was inspected, not executed.
